description: This bar chart illustrates quality scores for three categories: IFD, TagNum, and DEITA. The horizontal axis represents the categories, labeled “IFD Quality Scores,” “TagNum Quality Scores,” and “DEITA Quality Scores,” appearing in that order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “Scores,” displays a linear scale ranging from 30 to 70, with tick marks at intervals of 5. For each category, there are three bars representing different metrics: a dashed light blue bar labeled “Base AvgGain,” a solid light blue bar labeled “AvgGain,” and a solid orange bar labeled “AvgGap.” The IFD category shows a “Base AvgGain” bar reaching approximately 63.98, an “AvgGain” bar reaching approximately 41.90, and an “AvgGap” bar reaching approximately 41.90. The TagNum category displays a “Base AvgGain” bar reaching approximately 66.06, an “AvgGain” bar reaching approximately 39.13, and an “AvgGap” bar reaching approximately 39.13. Finally, the DEITA category shows a “Base AvgGain” bar reaching approximately 67.64, an “AvgGain” bar reaching approximately 37.91, and an “AvgGap” bar reaching approximately 42.99. The bars are grouped by category, with each metric represented by a bar within that group. The bars are not sorted in any apparent order, and no bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
